title: pretty IVYROSE|Plus Size Floral Applique Short Sleeve A-Line Chiffon Formal Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
Unleash your inner fashionista with this eye-catching Plus Size Floral Applique Short Sleeve A-Line Chiffon Evening Dress. Designed with a bust-friendly fit and curve-flattering A-line silhouette, this dress is perfect for glamorous events, red carpet occasions, or gala nights. The delicate floral applique and flowing chiffon fabric add a touch of elegance and romance to your ensemble.?

Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor length.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
